title: EC 1.2.4: PCA of k-sep. bigram PSSM
caption: PCA projection of all 1011 proteins in the EC 1.2.4 pool, described by k-sep. bigram PSSM (400 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.12. The first two components explain 65.2% and 5.7% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
